12	# Make /sc:issue --create set the GitHub issue type and the Complexity field
13	
14	Source: ./source.md
15	Goal: `/sc:issue --create` sets the issue type (Feature, Bug or Test) and the org's Complexity issue field on the new issue, applies only the mode label (`bug` or `enhancement`), no longer asks for `type:` or `complexity:` labels, and lists every classification it could not set in its final output and in a third return-contract block. The protocol, command, worker, templates, tests and docs all say the same thing.
16	
17	## Constraints
18	
19	- Edit only under `src/superclaude/`, `tests/`, `docs/` and `plugins/superclaude/skills/sc-recommend/refs/`. Never edit or stage anything under `.claude/` except `.claude/settings.json`; run `make sync-dev` after the `src/superclaude/` edits.
20	- Text inside the skill, command and agent files must not contain the string `src/superclaude/` (an installed-path rule; a test scans the skill folder for it).
21	- Every `gh issue`, `gh pr` and `gh label` line written into the skill, refs or agents carries `--repo <R>`. No file may contain a brace placeholder for owner and repo; use `<owner>` and `<R>`.
22	- `--claim` behaviour and text stay unchanged, including its two-block part of the return contract. The T1 and T2 worker files, `refs/tiers.md`, `scripts/*.py` and the four issue-body templates stay unchanged.
23	- The skill never creates a label, an issue type or an issue field. It writes exactly two things to a created issue besides the issue itself: the issue type (through `gh issue create --type`) and the Complexity field value (through one POST).
24	- Nothing in this plan writes to GitHub while it is executed. The POST body, the `--type` flag and the silent-drop behaviour come from GitHub's docs and `gh` help and are UNVERIFIED by a real run; Task 12 leaves the owner a manual check for that.
25	- Line numbers named in tasks come from the issue analysis on commit `1aa2e5c3` and must be re-read in the live file before each edit.
26	- Decisions taken as defaults (the owner may reverse them later): the T3 worker may read exactly `orgs/<owner of R>/issue-fields`; the `--type` area flag and its 11 values stay but no longer produce a label; the `bug` / `enhancement` mode labels stay.
27	
28	## Phase 1: Protocol rules
29	
30	## Task 1: Rewrite refs/labels.md as the rules for labels, issue type and fields
31	
32	Edit `src/superclaude/skills/sc-issue-protocol/refs/labels.md` and keep the file name (tests pin the five-ref inventory). Retitle it "Labels, issue type and fields" and keep the spawn-rule paragraph at the top. Source sections: decisions Q1, Q2, Q6, Q7, Q8; specification 2.1, 2.3, 2.4.
33	
34	The file must contain: the table of the only two labels the skill applies (`bug` for mode bug, `enhancement` for mode feature); the issue type rule (mode `bug` gives Bug; mode `feature` with area `tests` gives Test; every other feature gives Feature; Task is never chosen); the Complexity mapping (quick = Simple, standard = Medium, deep = Complex, matched to the field's option names without case sensitivity); the run-time steps in order (labels intersected with the repo labels in `scout.md`; `--type` only when the type is listed under `### Repo issue types`; read-back with `gh issue view <N> --repo <R> --json issueType --jq .issueType.name`; the POST with `gh api -X POST repos/<R>/issues/<N>/issue-field-values --input <file>` and body `{"issue_field_values":[{"field_id":<id>,"value":"<option name>"}]}`; read-back with `gh api repos/<R>/issues/<N>/issue-field-values`); and the three exact output line formats of specification 2.4. Remove the 11 `type: ...` labels, the 3 `complexity: ...` labels and their `gh label create` lines; keep only the `bug` and `enhancement` lines in the maintainer block.
35	
36	Acceptance criteria:
37	- `labels.md` contains no `type:` label and no `complexity:` label and no `gh label create` line for either.
38	- `labels.md` states Feature, Bug and Test with the Q7 rule, and Simple, Medium and Complex with the Q8 mapping.
39	- `labels.md` contains the three exact line formats `not applied: label missing in repo: <name>`, `not set: issue type <name>: <reason>` and `not set: field Complexity <value>: <reason>` with every reason listed in specification 2.4.
40	- `labels.md` uses `-X POST` for the field write, mentions `issue-field-values`, and contains no `-X PUT`.
41	- Every `gh issue` line in the file carries `--repo <R>`, and `uv run pytest tests/skills/test_issue_protocol.py -k "repo or placeholder" -v` still passes for this file.
42	
43	## Task 2: Update refs/create.md for the new lookup, flags and post steps
44	
45	Depends on: Task 1
46	
47	Edit `src/superclaude/skills/sc-issue-protocol/refs/create.md`. Source sections: decision Q4, specification 2.1, 2.3, 2.5. Four places change. First, the gh call rule paragraph near line 9: every `gh api` path stays `user` or `repos/<R>/...`, with one stated exception, the T3 lookup worker's read-only GET of `orgs/<owner of R>/issue-fields` (`<owner>` is the part of `<R>` before the slash; no other `orgs/` path; T1 and T2 keep the old rule); also add that the orchestrator's only GitHub field write is the POST of Task 1. Second, Wave 1 (lines 18 to 22): the T3 worker also runs `gh api repos/<R>/issue-types` and `gh api orgs/<owner of R>/issue-fields` and writes the sections `### Repo issue types` and `### Complexity field` into `scout.md`; a failed lookup is recorded as `lookup failed: <reason>` and never stops the run. Third, Wave 2 (lines 34 to 36): `flags.md` gets a derived `Issue type` row by the Q7 rule, and the Complexity row holds the option name. Fourth, Wave 5 (lines 61 to 69): replace the label step with the sequence of specification 2.1 (mode label only; `--type` when listed; `gh issue create` and the rename; type read-back; field POST and read-back; pushback comment; final output with every `not applied` and `not set` line). `E-CREATE-FAILED` and `E-POST-FAILED` keep their current meaning.
48	
49	Acceptance criteria:
50	- `create.md` names `issue-types` and `issue-fields` in Wave 1 and the two new `scout.md` section names.
51	- `create.md` states the single `orgs/<owner>/issue-fields` exception and that no other `orgs/` path is allowed.
52	- `create.md` Wave 5 no longer requests a `type:` or `complexity:` label, and lists the type read-back, the field POST with `-X POST`, and the final-output lines in the order of specification 2.1.
53	- `create.md` says a failed type or field never stops the run after the issue exists, and that a failure of `gh issue create` is still STOP `E-CREATE-FAILED`.
54	- `create.md` contains no `-X PUT`, no brace placeholder and no `src/superclaude/`.
55	
56	## Task 3: Update SKILL.md to match the new create behaviour and return contract
57	
58	Depends on: Task 1, Task 2
59	
60	Edit `src/superclaude/skills/sc-issue-protocol/SKILL.md`. Source sections: decisions Q4, Q6; specification 2.2, 2.3, 2.5. Change these places, re-reading the live line numbers first: the frontmatter description (line 3) and the create bullet (line 18) so they say the issue is filed with an issue type, the Complexity field and a mode label instead of "labels from a fixed set"; the files-table row for `refs/labels.md` (line 31); the GitHub call rules (lines 73 and 74): add the single `orgs/<owner of R>/issue-fields` read exception for the T3 worker and add the field POST and `gh issue create ... --type <name>` to the orchestrator's write list, workers still never write; the create steps 1 to 6 (lines 98 to 103) so Wave 1 and Wave 5 match `refs/create.md`; the return contract: keep the first block key for key and the claim block unchanged, add a third YAML block with exactly the keys `issue_type`, `complexity_field`, `classification_missing`, and the sentence "Create mode adds these three fields after the claim block (claim mode prints none of them; on a STOP the fields that do not apply are `null`)"; the error table row for a missing label (line 161) plus two new rows (issue type not available or not applied, Complexity field not available or write failed), both listed and non-fatal; and the Will Not list (lines 172 to 177): keep every existing item and add that the skill never creates an issue type or an issue field and never writes a field other than Complexity.
61	
62	Acceptance criteria:
63	- `SKILL.md` has no "labels from a fixed set" wording left, and its Will Not list still contains the tokens `/sc:implement`, `/task`, a commit, a push, `/sc:pr-submit`, "Merge anything." and "Pass an Orca link flag".
64	- The Return contract section holds exactly three YAML blocks; the first block's keys are unchanged and the third block's keys are exactly `issue_type`, `complexity_field`, `classification_missing`.
65	- The error table has a row for each of: missing label, issue type not set, Complexity field not set; each says skip or continue and list it in the final output; `gh issue create` failure stays STOP `E-CREATE-FAILED`.
66	- The call rules name the one `orgs/<owner of R>/issue-fields` exception and the field POST, and the file contains no `-X PUT`, no brace placeholder and no `src/superclaude/`.
67	
68	## Phase 2: Templates and lookup worker
69	
70	## Task 4: Update the scout, flags and create-review templates
71	
72	Depends on: Task 1
73	
74	Edit three files under `src/superclaude/skills/sc-issue-protocol/templates/`. Source sections: specification 2.1, section 3.1. In `scout-report.md` keep the Claim section as is and, in the Create section (lines 40 to 50), keep `### Repo labels` and `### Possible duplicates` and add `### Repo issue types` (one name per line, or `lookup failed: <reason>`) and `### Complexity field` (field id, data type, option names, or `not found` / `lookup failed: <reason>`). In `flags-decision.md` add an `Issue type` row (`<Feature | Bug | Test>`, reason: derived from mode and area by the rule in `refs/labels.md`) and change the Complexity row values to `<Simple | Medium | Complex>` while keeping the depth rule text. In `create-review-comment.md` change "The issue was not relabelled." (line 3) to "The issue was not reclassified." and keep the final line `<!-- sc:issue:create-review -->`.
75	
76	Acceptance criteria:
77	- `scout-report.md` Create section has the four headings `### Repo labels`, `### Possible duplicates`, `### Repo issue types`, `### Complexity field`, and the Claim section is byte-identical to before.
78	- `flags-decision.md` has an `Issue type` row and the Complexity row lists Simple, Medium and Complex.
79	- `create-review-comment.md` says "not reclassified" and its last non-empty line is still `<!-- sc:issue:create-review -->`; `uv run pytest tests/skills/test_issue_protocol.py -k "marker or template" -v` passes.
80	
81	## Task 5: Extend the create lookup job of the T3 worker
82	
83	Depends on: Task 2, Task 4
84	
85	Edit `src/superclaude/agents/issue-worker-t3.md`. Source sections: decision Q4, specification 2.1 and 2.3. In job 2 "Create lookup" (line 22) add the two reads `gh api repos/<R>/issue-types` and `gh api orgs/<owner of R>/issue-fields` (GET only, look up the field named `Complexity` and record its id, data type and option names), and the two new `scout.md` sections from Task 4; a failed read is recorded as `lookup failed: <reason>` and the worker continues. In the Rules section, the "Read-only GitHub access" bullet (line 27) keeps "a path that starts with `repos/<R>/`" and adds the single exception `orgs/<owner of R>/issue-fields` for this lookup only; the ban on writes and on `-X` other than `GET` stays word for word.
86	
87	Acceptance criteria:
88	- `issue-worker-t3.md` job 2 names `issue-types`, `issue-fields`, `### Repo issue types` and `### Complexity field`.
89	- The Read-only GitHub access rule names exactly one `orgs/` path, `orgs/<owner of R>/issue-fields`, and still forbids every write and every `-X` other than `GET`.
90	- The file contains no brace placeholder and no `src/superclaude/`; the T1 and T2 worker files are untouched (`git diff --stat` shows no change to them).
91	
92	## Phase 3: Command file
93	
94	## Task 6: Update the /sc:issue command file wording
95	
96	Depends on: Task 3
97	
98	Edit `src/superclaude/commands/issue.md`. Source sections: decisions Q5, Q6; section 3.1. Change the frontmatter description (line 4) and the create bullet (line 17) from "labels from a fixed set" to an issue type, the Complexity field and a mode label; the `--mode` row (line 41) to "Picks the feature or bug template, the Feature or Bug issue type and the `enhancement` / `bug` label"; the `--type` row (line 42) to say the area of the change, which selects issue type Test for a feature in `tests` and is otherwise recorded in `flags.md`, and no longer maps to a `type: <value>` label; the Will line for create (line 89) to "set the issue type and the Complexity field, apply only the mode label that already exists in the repo, and list everything it could not set"; and the Will Not line (line 93) to also say it creates no issue types or issue fields. The Options table values for `--type` stay the same 11 values. The file must not contain `src/superclaude/`.
99	
100	Acceptance criteria:
101	- `commands/issue.md` has no "labels from a fixed set" and no `type: <value>` label wording.
102	- The `--type` value list is unchanged, and `uv run pytest tests/skills/test_issue_protocol.py -k "command" -v` passes.
103	- The Will and Will Not lists agree with the skill's Will and Will Not lists on the new create behaviour.
104	
105	## Phase 4: Tests
106	
107	## Task 7: Update the existing protocol tests for the new contract
108	
109	Depends on: Task 3, Task 4, Task 5, Task 6
110	
111	Edit `tests/skills/test_issue_protocol.py`. Source section: 3.2 "Existing tests to update". In `test_st10_claim_return_contract_has_the_ten_fields_and_keeps_the_old_ones` (around lines 492 to 520) the Return contract section now holds three YAML blocks: change `len(blocks) == 2` to 3, keep the first two key lists exactly as they are, add an assertion that the third block's keys equal `["issue_type", "complexity_field", "classification_missing"]`, and assert that the sentence "Create mode adds these three fields after the claim block" is present in the section. Keep the existing assertion that claim mode's block says "create mode prints none of them". Re-run the Will / Will Not test (`test_skill_will_and_will_not_match_the_command_file`, line 527) and the five-ref inventory tests (lines 209 to 216, 233, 277); they must pass unchanged. Search the file for any other assertion on the old label wording ("fixed set", "type:", "complexity:", "relabelled") and update only those.
112	
113	Acceptance criteria:
114	- `uv run pytest tests/skills/test_issue_protocol.py -v` passes with the updated return-contract test.
115	- The updated test fails if the third YAML block is removed or a key is renamed (confirmed by reading the assertions: exact list equality, not a subset check).
116	- No test asserts the old label wording, and the five-ref inventory tests still count exactly five refs.
117	
118	## Task 8: Add the new rule tests
119	
120	Depends on: Task 7
121	
122	Add tests to `tests/skills/test_issue_protocol.py`, using the file's existing helpers (`_text`, `SKILL`, `REFS`, `TEMPLATES`, `AGENTS`, `SKILL_DIR`) and its conventions. Source section: 3.2 "New tests". Write one test per rule, each failing when the behaviour breaks. First, `labels.md` contains no `type:` label, no `complexity:` label and no `gh label create` line for either. Second, every `orgs/` path found by regex in the skill folder files and the `AGENTS` files equals `orgs/<owner of R>/issue-fields` or `orgs/<owner>/issue-fields` and appears only in `create.md`, `SKILL.md` and `issue-worker-t3.md`. Third, the skill folder and the agents contain `-X POST` together with `issue-field-values` and no `-X PUT`. Fourth, `create.md` and `labels.md` carry the three exact line formats `not applied: label missing in repo:`, `not set: issue type` and `not set: field Complexity`. Fifth, `issue-worker-t3.md` names `issue-types` and `issue-fields`, and `scout-report.md` has the headings `### Repo issue types` and `### Complexity field`. Sixth, `labels.md` states Feature, Bug, Test and Simple, Medium, Complex. Add one self-check test in the style of `test_fork_safety_scan_fails_on_a_ref_without_repo` (line 642) that feeds the `orgs/` scanner a text with `orgs/other/issue-fields` and expects it to be reported.
123	
124	Acceptance criteria:
125	- `uv run pytest tests/skills/test_issue_protocol.py -v` passes and the new tests are collected (the count of collected tests rises by at least seven).
126	- Reverting any one of Tasks 1 to 5 in a scratch copy would turn at least one new test red: each new test asserts on the text that task adds.
127	- The existing fork-safety scans (`test_every_gh_issue_pr_label_mention_carries_repo`, `test_no_brace_placeholder`, `test_no_source_tree_path_in_skill_files`) still pass.
128	
129	## Phase 5: Docs, mirror and owner check
130	
131	## Task 9: Update the user guide for the new create behaviour
132	
133	Depends on: Task 6
134	
135	Edit `docs/user-guide/commands.md` and `docs/user-guide/flags.md`. Source sections: decisions Q5, Q6, Q7; section 3.1. In `commands.md` the create description (line 349), the `--mode` row (line 365), the `--type` row (line 366) and the Will line (line 394) currently say labels from a fixed set and `type: <value>` labels: rewrite them to the new behaviour (issue type Feature, Bug or Test; Complexity field from depth; mode label only; anything not set is listed). In `flags.md` the `--mode` row (line 228) and `--type` row (line 229) get the same treatment. Keep the value lists of both flags unchanged.
136	
137	Acceptance criteria:
138	- Neither file says that `/sc:issue --create` applies `type:` or `complexity:` labels or labels "from a fixed set".
139	- Both files say the issue type and the Complexity field are set, the mode label is applied when it exists, and unset items are listed in the final output.
140	- The `--type` value list in both files is unchanged.
141	
142	## Task 10: Update the sc-issue command design document
143	
144	Depends on: Task 9
145	
146	Edit `docs/designs/sc-issue-command.md`. Source sections: decisions Q1 to Q8; section 3.1. Replace the statements that labels come from a fixed set or that `type:` and `complexity:` labels are applied, at the places listed by grep for "label" (around lines 18, 76, 77, 197, 207, 224, 225, 283 to 293, 354, 366, 370, 449, 479 and 492): the create bullet; the `--mode` and `--type` option rows; the Wave 1 lookup text (add the issue types and the Complexity field lookups and the single `orgs/` read); the Wave 2 sentence ending "not silently relabelled" (use "reclassified"); the Wave 5 step list; section 11 "Label set" (now: the two mode labels, the issue type rule and the Complexity field mapping, with a note that the `type:` and `complexity:` labels were dropped because the repo has none); the error row for a missing label; the file-table rows for `SKILL.md` return contract keys and `refs/labels.md`; the gh flags table row for `gh issue create` (add `--type`) and the acceptance line 6. Keep rule B7 ("none are created on the fly") true and add that no issue type or field is created either. Leave history and decision-log entries as they are except for wording that is now false.
147	
148	Acceptance criteria:
149	- `docs/designs/sc-issue-command.md` no longer says that `type: <type>` or `complexity: <...>` labels are applied, and its section 11 matches `refs/labels.md` from Task 1.
150	- The `gh issue create` row lists `--type`, and the return contract description lists `issue_type`, `complexity_field` and `classification_missing`.
151	- Every `gh api` path in the file spells `repos/<R>/...` except the one documented `orgs/<owner of R>/issue-fields` read.
152	
153	## Task 11: Update HOW-WE-WORK.md and its plugin mirror
154	
155	Depends on: Task 3
156	
157	Edit `src/superclaude/core/HOW-WE-WORK.md` at line 329 (the `/sc:issue` row that says "labels from a fixed set"): change that phrase to "an issue type, the Complexity field and a mode label". Then copy the whole file byte for byte to `plugins/superclaude/skills/sc-recommend/refs/HOW-WE-WORK.md` (same line 329). Then search `src/superclaude/core/CLAUDE.md` for the same phrase; if it appears (the level table copy), change it identically there, otherwise leave that file alone.
158	
159	Acceptance criteria:
160	- `cmp src/superclaude/core/HOW-WE-WORK.md plugins/superclaude/skills/sc-recommend/refs/HOW-WE-WORK.md` reports no difference.
161	- "labels from a fixed set" no longer appears in either file or in `src/superclaude/core/CLAUDE.md`.
162	- `uv run pytest tests -k "how_we_work or HOW_WE_WORK or level_table" -v` passes, or, if no test matches that expression, `grep -rl "HOW-WE-WORK" tests` names the tests that check the mirror and they pass.
163	
164	## Task 12: Sync the dev copies, run the checks and write the owner's manual check
165	
166	Depends on: Task 8, Task 10, Task 11
167	
168	Run `make sync-dev`, then `make verify-sync`, `make lint` and `uv run pytest tests/skills/test_issue_protocol.py -v`; fix any failure at its source in `src/superclaude/`, never by editing `.claude/`. Then write `./artifacts/owner-manual-check.md` in this package. It states, in plain bullets, the single manual check the owner runs after merge because no step of this plan wrote to GitHub: file one test issue with `/sc:issue --create "<short test description>" --mode feature --type tests --depth standard` on `IronbellyOrg/IronClaude`, confirm the issue shows type Test and Complexity Medium, and check that the final output lists any `not set` line; repeat once with `--mode bug` and confirm type Bug. It also records the three UNVERIFIED points from the source section 3.4 (POST body, `--type` flag, silent drop without push access) and the four defaults the owner may reverse (the `orgs/` read exception, keeping the `--type` flag, keeping the mode labels, area `tests` giving Test).
169	
170	Acceptance criteria:
171	- `make verify-sync` and `make lint` exit 0 and the whole `tests/skills/test_issue_protocol.py` file passes; the outputs are saved to `./artifacts/t12-checks.log`.
172	- `git status --short` shows no path under `.claude/` other than `.claude/settings.json` in the set of staged or tracked changes.
173	- `./artifacts/owner-manual-check.md` exists and holds the two test-issue checks, the three UNVERIFIED points and the four reversible defaults.

## Phase 1: Protocol rules

## Task 1: Rewrite refs/labels.md as the rules for labels, issue type and fields

Edit `src/superclaude/skills/sc-issue-protocol/refs/labels.md` and keep the file name (tests pin the five-ref inventory). Retitle it "Labels, issue type and fields" and keep the spawn-rule paragraph at the top. Source sections: decisions Q1, Q2, Q6, Q7, Q8; specification 2.1, 2.3, 2.4.
